newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mycom up, Repco falls on gaming news.
newsitem.headline: Mycom up, Repco falls on gaming news.

text.p: Shares of Mycom Bhd jumped in early trading on news a subsidiary company has had its gaming licence renewed in eastern Sabah state, analysts said.
Shares of Sabah gaming rival, Repco Holdings Bhd, fell on the same news announcement, they said.
Mycom's 54.7 percent unit, Olympia Industries Bhd, said on Tuesday its gaming licence its Sabah has been renewed by the Ministry of Finance from January 1, 1997.
At 0242 GMT, Mycom was up two cents at 3.76 ringgit, after touching a high of 4.0, while Repco was down 1.75 to 79.75.

"I think it's expected that Repco should come down and Mycom come up on the news," said a head of research at a local brokerage. Olympia reported a 35 percent fall in net earnings for the year to June 30, 1996, saying it was partly due to the loss of the licence.
A gaming analyst noted that Repco and Olympia offered different gaming activities in Sabah and that investors should not worry that Repco's market share may flow to Olympia.
